specifically docs promise altered Raw().Do and Add/Update semantics not authorized by the task and therefore lock in an unintended contract, while the seek-to-end measurement can itself fail or move unusual ReadSeekers before any request, adding new preflight errors to existing methods, and no test covers nonzero starting offsets, failed seeks, ownership preservation, redirects, or concurrent GetBody use; these global changes are unnecessary because multipartbody.NewFile already yields a replayable buffered body for Upload and thus solve a separate perceived issue at the RawClient layer while the contract deliberately says to preserve Add as the lower-level custom-body API unchanged, making B substantially more invasive and less mergeable even though its focused Upload tests are comparatively stronger and its documentation is polished but inaccurate relative to the prescribed scope and omission of the required source-reader failure case remains unresolved"]}
